name: InfoDensity-DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. An RL post-train of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B (8.03B, hidden 4096, 32 layers, 131072 max positions) using InfoDensity, a reward that combines an entropy-trajectory quality term with group-relative length scaling and is applied only to traces that reach a correct answer. Same config.json and tensor set as the base; ships merged weights. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-02. Best-evidenced record in this batch: all four benchmarks are in one table with a base row, greedy pass@1, 16384-token generation cap, and the card states both rows were scored with the released evaluation code so a run of it reproduces the numbers. The claim is efficiency as much as accuracy — mean generated length falls from 9.4k to 6.5k tokens while accuracy rises 47.6 to 58.4 — and AIME24 (40.0 vs 23.3) is the largest single gain. CAVEATS: the paper is cited as EMNLP 2026 Main but the repo carries no arxiv tag, so the method is not independently checkable from the card; GPQA-Diamond at 30.8 is low in absolute terms and a 7.6-point move on a 198-question set is within a couple of standard errors; and a custom RL reward tuned on math traces can overfit to the four benchmarks it was selected on. Kind recorded as 'rl', not 'finetune'.
